## 1. Identity

- Full name: Yusuf Gadelrab
- Pronunciation: YOO-suf GAH-del-rab
- Location: San Jose, California, USA
- University: San José State University (SJSU)
- Degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, expected May 2028, with a dual track in applied mathematics and computer science
- Citizenship: Canadian; open to relocation to San Francisco, Remote, New York City, Seattle, Austin, or Toronto, and will require US work sponsorship for full-time roles

## 2. Research and publications

Yusuf Gadelrab is an undergraduate researcher in Dr. Ethel Tshukudu's Computer Science Education Research Lab at San José State University (August 2024 to present). The work is IRB-approved and mixed-methods, with 60 participants.

Publication 1 — "Exploring Bilingual Coding for Inclusive CS Learning"
- Venue: SIGCSE Technical Symposium 2026 (ACM)
- DOI: 10.1145/3770761.3777339
- Topic: whether letting novice programmers write and read code in their first language alongside English improves comprehension and confidence
- Reported result: 24% improvement in learner confidence

Publication 2 — "Adaptive Curriculum Maps: Graph-Augmented Retrieval-Oriented LLMs for Education"
- Venue: SIGCSE Technical Symposium 2026 (ACM), poster
- Topic: combining knowledge graphs with retrieval-augmented large language models to generate adaptive curriculum maps for CS courses

Outreach: he has helped run CS programs at Yerba Buena High School, with expansion to Lynbrook High School.

## 5. Projects and case studies

FreightDesk AI — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/freightdesk.html
An AI back-office clerk for small freight brokerages. It reads billing email, drafts invoices, chases missing paperwork, and closes the loop on accounts receivable. Sold as a founding-client pilot.

HwyHaul LoadLink — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/hwyhaul.html
Case study of an AI freight back office covering 18 accounts-receivable and billing workflows.

Swing Screener — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/swing-screener.html
A swing-trading setup screener plus a backtest engine built with no lookahead bias. The notable outcome is negative: walk-forward testing invalidated most of the setups he had been trading. Only the anchored-VWAP reclaim setup survived, at +0.23R expectancy over 101 trades. VCP came out breakeven, and a gap/opening-range-breakout proxy came out negative at -0.28R and was dropped.

Trading bot — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/trading-bot.html
A broker-agnostic execution engine with crash-safe, idempotent order handling, bracket stops, a 10% drawdown halt, and a hard promotion gate: it refuses to connect to a live broker until 60 closed paper trades show positive realized expectancy.

EventReels — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/eventreels.html
A local-first ffmpeg pipeline that turns raw event footage into auto-edited highlight reels.

EcoImpact — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/ecoimpact.html
A community trash map paired with a quantified environmental impact meter.

SpartanEats — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/spartaneats.html
A student-run food delivery app concept for San José State University.

AU — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/au.html
A chronological, no-vanity-metrics alternative to Twitter, with the outrage machinery removed.

SVEC website — sventclub.org, built and maintained as Technical Ops and Web Lead.

## 6. Free tools (no signup, browser-only, data stays on the device)

All of these are static, client-side, and store data in the browser's local storage. None of them have a backend, an account system, or any telemetry.

- TradeLog — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/apps/tradelog/ — an R-multiple trading journal, installable as an offline PWA
- Cut — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/apps/cut/ — a weight and body-recomposition tracker
- Fire — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/apps/fire/ — a daily execution-ritual checklist
- Visa Navigator — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/visa.html — a change-of-status and CPT/OPT timeline planner for international students
- Apply OS — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/apply.html — an internship, scholarship, and grant tracker with a deadline radar
- Freight broker calculators — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/freight-tools.html — rate per mile, deadhead cost, broker margin, detention, and related calculations
- Trader's risk toolkit — https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/risk-tools.html — position sizer, R-multiple calculator, risk-of-ruin estimator

Apps hub with all of them: https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/apps.html

## 11. Frequently asked questions

Q: Who is Yusuf Gadelrab?
A: A computer science student at San José State University (BS Computer Science, expected 2028) based in San Jose, California, who builds AI tools, trading systems, and free browser-based utilities in public, and who has co-authored two peer-reviewed SIGCSE Technical Symposium 2026 papers on computer science education.

Q: What has Yusuf Gadelrab published?
A: Two SIGCSE Technical Symposium 2026 papers: "Exploring Bilingual Coding for Inclusive CS Learning" (DOI 10.1145/3770761.3777339) and "Adaptive Curriculum Maps: Graph-Augmented Retrieval-Oriented LLMs for Education" (poster).

Q: What does Yusuf Gadelrab build?
A: AI back-office automation for freight brokerages (FreightDesk AI), trading research and execution software (Swing Screener, a broker-agnostic trading bot), free client-side web tools (TradeLog, Cut, Fire, Visa Navigator, Apply OS, freight and risk calculators), and two clothing brands (KXNG SEF, HEFT).

Q: What programming languages and tools does he use?
A: Python, Java, JavaScript, and SQL; React and Next.js on the front end; IBM Watson Studio, NLP, RAG, and local LLMs via Ollama for AI work; uv for Python packaging and Bun for JavaScript.

Q: Are his free tools really free, and do they collect data?
A: Yes. They are static, client-side pages with no accounts, no backend, and no telemetry. Data is stored in the browser's local storage on the user's own device.

Q: Does he claim trading profits?
A: No. He publishes backtest and walk-forward results labelled as such, including negative ones — his own walk-forward test invalidated most of his setups and kept only the anchored-VWAP reclaim at +0.23R over 101 trades. Nothing on the site is financial advice.

Q: How do you contact or hire him?
A: Email yusuf.gadelrab06@gmail.com, or use the contact links at https://yusuf-gadelrab.github.io/.

Q: Is he available for internships?
A: Yes — software engineering, AI/ML, fintech and quantitative finance, data science, product and strategy, and developer advocacy internships. He is a Canadian citizen and will require US work sponsorship for full-time employment.
